baseline_object.definition: equal-weight blend of the nine frozen checkpoints (TLOB/MLPLOB/dual-scale Patch x seeds 11/29/47); the deployable incumbent submission build, blend weights sha256 93df1dfb89eb187033f8e0f0225f39ea9ce86a5078d12514af1f7c098393ae5a
baseline_object.why: promotion means replacing the incumbent that is currently deployable

decision_rule.economic: net return at the 5bp stress rate may regress by no more than net5_limit
not_gated: official cross-submission rank composite (not reproducible locally)
wall time (no platform limit has been declared; reported only)
decision_rule.practical: the observed paired improvement must be at least min_improvement
decision_rule.repeat: at least ceil(0.75 x declared periods) periods must show a positive paired effect
decision_rule.resource: measured peak host RSS across all subprocesses must stay at or below the pre-registered 24 GiB platform line with 15% headroom
decision_rule.secondary: no secondary metric may regress by more than its measured limit
decision_rule.statistical: the 5-day consecutive-block 95% interval of the paired daily difference must exclude zero (lower bound > 0)

derived_thresholds.estimator: min_improvement = round_up(primary_grid, max(placebo_max_abs_primary_difference, relative_floor * baseline_primary_level)); secondary_limit[m] = round_up(grid[m], placebo_max_abs_difference[m])

economic_risk_boundary.collapse_rule: If a time-consistency change lowers turnover but collapses IC or the long-short spread, the conclusion is 'not economical at 5bp'; that is recorded as a failed candidate, the fact that the official score contains no cost term is recorded separately, and no earlier version is re-promoted.
must_not: relax the 5bp stress scenario to 0bp/2bp or average across scenarios
lower min_improvement or any secondary limit because cost makes a candidate look uneconomical
read a cost-scenario result as a signal-quality improvement
report the official score as if it included a cost term
economic_risk_boundary.official_score_note: the published score aggregates IC mean, IC_IR, long-short Sharpe, stress stability and turnover ranks across submissions and contains no transaction-cost term; 5bp economics is a local stress gate, never an official score component

evidence_rules.date_evidence_unit: one trading day; resampling unit is a block of consecutive trading days inside one declared period and blocks never cross a period gap

measured_volatility.note: seed dispersion is descriptive only; intervals come from 5-day consecutive-day blocks inside each disjoint month, never from seed count or same-day stocks

metric_caliber_layers.cost_scenario_independence: the four cost scenarios (0/2/5/10bp) share one turnover series: turnover is rate-independent, so it is never differenced across scenarios or reported per scenario

local_proxy.definition: eval-v2 turnover = U / 2 with drift-aware pre-trade weights
local_proxy.use: monotone directional evidence only; lower is better

must_not: treat the local U/2 level as the official turnover score
convert the local turnover into a predicted official percentile or composite
mix turnover numbers computed under different cost rates
metric_caliber_layers.official_turnover: cross-submission relative rank percentile of the turnover metric; not computable locally because the submission population is unavailable

notes: The gate refuses any candidate whose evaluation started before registered_at, and refuses a pre-registration whose bytes changed after registration.
Screening runs on a subset of periods are not promotion decisions: the engine reports days outside the declared periods and the gate cannot accept.
0.0046 is retired, not rescaled: the replacement comes from the measured pair differences on these same 104 days.

object_policy_template.threshold_rationale: Primary floor = max(largest |paired daily difference| among the six equal-quality 3-seed/blend pairs, 2% of the measured baseline level). The six pairs are the three 3-seed trunk ensembles and the nine-checkpoint blend that contains them, so the largest pair difference is an upper bound on how far a nominally equivalent alternative sits from the incumbent; requiring more than that difference is stricter than 2% of the baseline level. Every secondary limit is the same largest |difference| for that metric, so a candidate may not give back more than one measured spurious-difference scale on any secondary metric. Pair set, estimator and grids were declared in the measurement plan before any metric was computed.

pre_registration_completeness.comparison_rule: paired by trading day; 5-day consecutive-block intervals resampled inside disjoint declared periods
pre_registration_completeness.independence_rule: seed count and the number of same-day stocks are never independent date evidence

ordering.enforced_by: scripts/promotion_gate.py refuses a candidate whose evaluation started before registered_at

pre_registration_completeness.retired_thresholds: 0.0046 and 0.0023 are retired and never usable for promotion

secondary_degradation_lines.note: RankIC is the primary improvement axis; Pearson IC carries the same axis as a non-degradation line

purpose: replace the carried-over 0.0046 improvement threshold with one measured on this data, and fix the secondary regression lines and the resource budget before any B-stage candidate is evaluated

resource_budget.applies_to: training run and submission inference package, host RSS across all subprocesses
resource_budget.gpu_note: GPU memory has no declared platform limit yet and is reported, not gated
resource_budget.note: 24 GiB platform caliber on host RSS across all subprocesses; 15% headroom leaves 3687 MiB for platform variance; GPU memory and wall time stay report-only until the platform declares their limits
resource_budget.platform_caliber: 24 GiB container memory reported by the B-stage platform measurement task
